bank.explanation: Reflective studs on the right-hand edge of the motorway (next to the central reservation) are amber to help drivers navigate in low visibility.
A 'Statutory Off-Road Notification' (SORN) only applies to vehicles kept off public roads; any vehicle parked or driven on a public road must be taxed.
bank.question: You may park your car on a public road without road tax if you have declared it off-road via a SORN.
